title: Target-Free Prime-Power Reduction, Short-Arc Cubic Obstructions, and Inverse-Frobenius Classifications for Agrawal's Conjecture
decided_scope: Target-free radical/multiplicity equivalence for F_n = 0 mod (n, X^r-1), explicit cubic primitive-prime bound p >= max(r^2+2, 1+N(floor((r-1)/4))) ~ r^3/384, and complete inverse-Frobenius cyclotomic norm classification
open_boundaries: Unrestricted squarefree composite counterexamples to Agrawal's conjecture
